description: Turnkey AI visibility report for a domain across a query set. Composes check_citations over every query (or a saved panel) and returns the metrics AI-visibility trackers sell as a dashboard, in one call: mention frequency (citation_rate), share_of_voice vs competitors, average rank when cited, and brand sentiment from the answer text. Side effects: one check_citations call per query (costs API quota for uncached queries; cached queries are free). Returns structured summary + top_domains + per_query, plus a rendered Markdown report (include_markdown=true) suitable for a public page. Provide queries[] or a panel name. Same engine selection as check_citations.

brand_terms.description: Brand name variants to detect in answer text for sentiment (defaults to the domain's second-level label).

competitors.description: Optional competitor domains to surface explicitly in the share-of-voice table.

domain.description: The domain you are measuring visibility for (e.g. automatelab.tech).

engine.description: AI engine to query. 'auto' picks the first configured key. Same selection as check_citations.

include_markdown.description: If true (default), include a rendered Markdown report under `markdown`.

max_results.description: Max citations to pull per query.

panel.description: Name of a saved panel (see panel_track) to pull queries from. Provide this OR `queries`.

queries.description: Queries to run. Provide this OR `panel`. Each is sent to the AI engine via check_citations.

name: report_visibility

markdown.description: Rendered Markdown report. Present when include_markdown=true.

average_rank.description: Mean citation rank when cited (null if never cited).

average_sentiment.description: Mean sentiment [-1,1] of answer text mentioning the brand (null if never mentioned).

citation_rate.description: Mention frequency: % of queries where the domain is cited.

share_of_voice.description: % of all cited sources across the query set that belong to the domain.
